implementation_policy: libuipc 0.0.28 CUDA IPC solve (tools/native/simulate.py) of an ivory cotton T-shirt (24,150-vertex sewn shell, strain-limiting Baraff-Witkin membrane plus discrete shell bending, effective E 0.3 MPa, 400 kg/m^3 x 0.45 mm = 180 g/m^2, friction 0.6) released from a gravity-prepared state with its lowest point 0.82 m above the floor onto the right Stable Neo-Hookean foam seat cushion (E 12 kPa, 35 kg/m^3, bottom 18 mm attached) of a fixed sofa; passive quadratic air drag is an external force, dt 1/240 s, 96 states at (k-1)/24 s plus three solver states per frame for a 1/60 s exposure (shutter_positions.npz). The four edits change only their DSL-bound parameter (tools/native/edit_vocab.py); the timed edit low_friction_at_frame_10 restores the shirt and seat FEM positions and velocities of frame 10 from the source cache (--source-cache) and continues with the edited friction, frames 1-9 being the source samples. tools/native/render.py replays the native states and exposure samples in Blender Cycles (camera from assets presentation.json); tools/native/realism.py is the published look over it (afternoon sun, room material wear). simulate/render entries launch through tools/native/pool_job.py (GPU policy ranking, lease, UUID binding, receipt under renders/cotton_tshirt_sofa/). build_pcve verifies the accepted delivery (tools/retained_delivery.py: native states bound to their render reports) and the timed edit's merged cache in the published suite; tools/export_ground_truth.py writes pcve_ground_truth/1. Effective material parameters, not fitted to a measured product.
